sloka: काका वाश्यन्ति तत्रैव बिडाला वै द्विपादयः ।। ७.६.५७ ॥
transliteration: kākā vāśyanti tatraiva biḍālā vai dvipādayaḥ ।। 7.6.57 ॥

translations.english: Disregarding those omens, the Rakshasas, proud of their strength and bound by the noose of death, continued to advance and did not turn back.
